g.text: CMU Sphinx reference: how one Baum-Welch step really runs (50.cd_hmm_tied, same shape for 20 and 30)
init_mixw copies CI model into CD model
forward-backward over its slice of fileids
LaunchScript norm.<iter>, deps = all bw jobs
norm.log "Only n of N parts ... failed"
next round of bw + norm jobs
The iteration chain is recursive and lives inside the queue
(norm job launches the next slave_convg). Only the first
slave_convg.pl returns to the caller, after polling the logs.
On Queue::PBS the accumulator cleanup is skipped ("NFS bugs").
